description: Minimal dramatiq project with two @dramatiq.actor consumers and producer call sites using .send() and .send_with_options(). Used by the extraction-quality benchmark to verify PRODUCES/CONSUMES edge emission for dramatiq.

expected_relationships.note: #6490 arm B. `def process_checkout(user_id: int, amount: float) -> None:` at module level.
The decorated function itself, distinct from the SCOPE.Service actor twin.
`@dramatiq.actor(queue_name="billing", max_retries=3)` — the task_routing pattern carrying the queue binding. Its name collides with the function's, so the kind is what separates them.
`from workers.billing import charge_card, send_receipt` — resolves across files to the real definition, not a placeholder.
The producer→consumer link: the checkout flow enqueues work that workers/billing.py's charge_card actor performs. It is the only edge that crosses from the producing file to the consuming one.

#6490 arm B FINDING, closed by #6741 arm 4: python-rq-mini emitted ENQUEUES for the structurally identical `queue.enqueue(send_email, …)` while dramatiq emitted only the generic REFERENCES for `charge_card.send(…)` — same language, same shape of producer, two different answers to "what enqueues onto this actor". ADR-0028 §3 settles it onto one pair per hop, and this is the pair RQ already ships, so dramatiq joins ENQUEUES rather than growing a PRODUCES edge beside it. The REFERENCES row above stays pinned: PRODUCES/ENQUEUES supplement the generic edges, they do not replace them (ADR-0028 §2).

`send_receipt.send_with_options(args=[user_id, amount], delay=2000)` — the options form of the same hop. This row also pins the evidence guard that makes the hop reachable at all: api/checkout.py never imports dramatiq, so `send_with_options` — a dramatiq-specific method name — is what identifies the file as a dispatch site, and it is what lets the bare `charge_card.send(…)` on the line above be read as dramatiq rather than a socket write.

#6490 arm B FINDING: the SCOPE.Service actor twin asserted as a must-have ENTITY has no edges at all — nothing contains it, nothing enqueues onto it, and it does not reach the function it decorates. Both C# job fixtures DO connect their SCOPE.Service twin to the job method; dramatiq's is a graph orphan.
